readRules.output:
1	Architecture rules for this TypeScript service. They govern every .ts file under src/. An import is any import in the file itself: import, import type, export ... from, and import().
2	Files in src/domain must not import anything from src/app.
3	Files in src/domain must not import anything from src/infra.
4	Files in src/domain must not import anything from src/config.
5	Files in src/domain and src/app must not import the pg package.
6	Files in src/app may use infrastructure only through src/infra/index.ts; they must not import any file in a folder inside src/infra.
7	Files in src/domain, src/app and src/infra must not contain process.env anywhere, comments included.
8	In src/config, process.env.NAME is allowed only for these names: PORT, DATABASE_URL, LOG_LEVEL, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_FROM, INVOICE_PREFIX. Anywhere in a src/config file, comments included, process.env.NAME with any other name and process.env[...] are not allowed; other forms, such as destructuring or process.env?.NAME, are not covered.
